title: Linux security basics
description: The Linux events every security baseline asks for first: SSH brute force, denied sudo and failed su, writes to /etc/shadow and /etc/passwd, account changes, new SSH keys, and PAM authentication failures.

splunkbaseApps.displayName: Splunk Add-on for Unix and Linux

requiredData.notes: Enable the /var/log/secure (or auth.log) monitor and the rlog.sh scripted input in Splunk_TA_nix. auditd needs watch rules on /etc/shadow, /etc/passwd, and authorized_keys (CIS / STIG identity rules).

industrySources.control: CIS Linux benchmark: auditd identity watches, sudo and su logging
MITRE ATT&CK T1098.004 SSH authorized keys

curationNotes: Skips UC-1.1.92 auditd daemon health (custom TA-linux-auditd-health collector) and AIDE file-integrity UCs.
